title: 墨西哥城产权侵占案增多 业主维权路漫长
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This type of crime is on top of mind for everybody in Mexico City right now.
segments.zh: 这类犯罪眼下是墨西哥城所有人最关心的问题。

segments.en: Each day, an average of 11 homes are effectively stolen in Mexico City.
segments.zh: 墨西哥城平均每天有11处住宅被实际侵占。

segments.en: The police can't keep up with a sheer number of home invasions.
segments.zh: 警方难以应对数量庞大的入室侵占案件。

segments.en: A cualquier persona que tema perder su casa, no está sola.
segments.zh: 任何担心失去住所的人，都不是孤身一人。

segments.en: The government's trying to keep up, but the underlying causes are more difficult to nail down.
segments.zh: 政府正努力跟进，但根本原因更难确定。

segments.en: These property crimes legally refer to as dispossession because criminals invading a property take possession, but don't usually become the owners.
segments.zh: 这类财产犯罪在法律上称为剥夺占有，因为罪犯侵入房产后占据使用，但通常不会成为所有者。

segments.en: So, how does someone actual steal property in Mexico?
segments.zh: 那么，在墨西哥有人是如何实际侵占房产的？

segments.en: Criminals will stake out a property, monitoring when it will be vacant for an extended period of time. While the owner might be away in vacation, they will forcibly enter,
segments.zh: 罪犯会盯梢一处房产，观察其何时长期空置。当业主可能外出度假时，他们强行进入，

segments.en: change the locks, falsify a deed, and sometimes even start renovations.
segments.zh: 更换门锁，伪造房契，有时甚至开始装修。

segments.en: The original owner will return to find their property invaded and themselves locked out.
segments.zh: 原业主回来时发现房产被侵占，自己反而被锁在门外。

segments.en: From there, the owner will start the police report in a lengthy legal process follows.
segments.zh: 此后，所有者将启动报警程序，随之而来的是漫长的法律流程。

segments.en: There are a lot of cases where it's very complicated for authorities to figure out who's the rightful owner.
segments.zh: 许多案件中，当局很难确定谁是合法所有者。
